description: P1-A: SKU visual render on zones (#16) and Remove SKU (#18). Render catalogue RENDER assets (PNG/JPEG) on zones via Konva Image with signed URL loading and fallback to sku_code text. Add removeSku action to projectStore with history push and permission check.
steps: 1. Create frontend/src/canvas/layers/SkuPlacementLayer.tsx: A new layer controlled by CanvasLayer.SKU_PLACEMENT visibility. For each zone that has a zoneSku entry, render the SKU's render asset as a Konva Image scaled to fit the zone bounds. Use supabase.storage.from('catalogue-assets').createSignedUrl(fileRef, 3600) to get a time-limited signed URL. Cache loaded images in a React ref/Map keyed by file_reference to avoid re-fetching. On load failure or missing asset, fall back to rendering sku_code as Konva Text centered in the zone. Convert coordinates using wallHeight (screenY = wallHeight - zone.y_mm - zone.height_mm). Layer is read-only (listening={false}).

2. To get the render asset file_reference for each zone's SKU, add a new derived state or selector. The skuStore already has thumbnailUrl in SkuWithCatalogue. For the canvas layer, create a utility hook frontend/src/canvas/utils/useSkuRenderUrls.ts that: takes the zoneSku Map, fetches the catalogue_asset.file_reference for RENDER type for each SKU (via fromTable query or from existing SkuWithCatalogue data), then calls supabase.storage.from('catalogue-assets').createSignedUrl() for each. Return a Map<zoneId, signedUrl>. Use useEffect + state to handle async loading. Cache results and refresh when zoneSku changes.

3. Add SkuPlacementLayer to frontend/src/canvas/CanvasContainer.tsx between ZonesLayer and the new LightingLayer (z-order: Grid > WallOutline > Zones > SkuPlacement > Lighting > Furniture > Trims > Measurements > Selection). Import and render <SkuPlacementLayer wallHeight={wallHeight} />.

4. Add removeSku action to frontend/src/stores/projectStore.ts: removeSku(zoneId: string) that: checks project not FINALIZED, removes the zoneSku entry from the Map, deletes the template_zone_sku row via fromTable('template_zone_sku').delete().eq('zone_id', zoneId). Does NOT push history itself (caller is responsible).

5. Create frontend/src/canvas/interactions/useSkuRemove.ts hook: takes history from useHistory, checks canEditZone permission (from usePermissionEnforcement), pushes current zones state to history, then calls projectStore.removeSku(zoneId). Exported as { removeSku: (zoneId: string) => void }.

6. Add a 'Remove SKU' button to frontend/src/components/ZonePropertiesPanel.tsx in the SKU section (only shown when a SKU is assigned). On click, call the removeSku hook/action with permission check and history push.

7. Add tests in frontend/src/canvas/__tests__/SkuPlacementLayer.test.tsx: mock supabase storage, test that layer renders Image for zones with SKU, falls back to Text when no asset, respects layerVisibility toggle. Add tests for removeSku in a new test file frontend/src/stores/__tests__/projectStore.removeSku.test.ts.
acceptance_criteria: SkuPlacementLayer renders Konva Image elements for zones with assigned SKUs that have RENDER assets
When a RENDER asset is unavailable or fails to load, the sku_code text is displayed as fallback
removeSku action removes the zone-SKU mapping from state and deletes the DB row
Remove SKU button in ZonePropertiesPanel is gated by permission check
History is pushed before SKU removal so undo restores the previous state
All tests pass including new tests for the layer and removal
